collection.description: A child feels embarrassed after mispronouncing a word and hearing laughter.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) feels embarrassed after mispronouncing a word and hearing laughter.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Friends explain they were surprised, not mocking (child).

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (adult), a teacher, reminds the group to be considerate.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) chooses a different word and keeps speaking.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult), a caregiver, explains the difference between laughing together and laughing at someone.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) invents a harmless joke everyone enjoys.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) feels calmer after a quiet moment.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) returns to the group when ready.
